method: Five complete pinned files read. Original NEWS-COPY preprocessing function and20 original test method bodies AST-extracted and executed without imports. Targeted nonASCII examples also executed.
findings: All20original NEWS-COPY method bodies pass locally. Function strips selected punctuation, joins hyphen-newline, replaces newline by space then removes all nonASCII bytes. Russian Привет and Chinese 世界 both become empty; café becomes caf. Intentional lossy benchmark normalization cannot establish file equality.

normalize lowercases, replaces Unicode digits with0 and removes punctuation/control/symbol categories without inserting boundaries. Distinct numeric values and punctuation-separated words can collapse; spaces are not collapsed. regex-based function tests were read but not executed.
ftfy_utils only reexports external fix_encoding/fix_text; no owned implementation or runtime proof in this file.
sha1_hash arbitrary d uses digest[:d//8], so nonbyte widths round down, values beyond160 do not increase entropy and negative d uses Python negative slicing. No explicit range validation shown.

xxh3_hash arbitrary-width fallback calls xxh3_128_digest(data) without seed; unlike32/64/128branches it ignores supplied seed and truncates whole bytes. Source verified, actual xxhash fallback not executed.

Hash tests use known MD5 vectors and SHA1 examples plus width/range and consistency assertions. Arbitrary xxh3 width tests only24/40 with default seed; no fallback seed distinction or nonbyte/negative-width contract coverage. Cryptographic hash wrappers use usedforsecurity=False.

result.scope: Original news_copy_preprocessing and20 original test method bodies, imports omitted through AST extraction. normalize/regex/ftfy and full pytest not executed.

limits: No full pytest, regex/ftfy/xxhash runtime or production changes. Local20-method result is not full upstream suite. pHash/ASAN deferred.
